# generated

## Overview
Generated AnalysisServer client interface (AnalysisServer) for Dart Analysis Server API.

## Interface
- com.google.dart.server.generated.AnalysisServer

## Invariants
- Auto-generated API defining all DAS request methods (e.g. analysis_setAnalysisRoots, completion_getSuggestions).

## Side Effects
- Submits JSON-RPC requests to the running Dart Analysis Server instance.
